levels.surface: الحسن بن عبد الله بن المغيرة

notes: «[3/128] رجال الكشي:» is the compiler's citation, not a link; the author of the cited book (Kashshi) is not written as a transmitter in this report, so the ruling
The first route ends at «العباس بن عامر القصباني» and the second («؛ و أيوب بن نوح ...») runs on to Ibn Abi Ya'fur; the two are not merged
The Imam «أبو عبد الله» is met inside the narrated encounter («دخلت على أبي عبد الله ... فقال») and is not made a link: the Imam speaks and acts in a scene, which is the ruling
